description: Thin C# wrapper over window.tmDocumentEditorPerformance. Use from benchmarks, manual profiling, or automated regression guards. The probe is not part of the editor's normal hot path — instantiate around a discrete action and dispose / stop when finished.

members.name: ClearAllAsync
members.description: Clears all active captures globally. Mainly used by tests.

members.name: NoteInteropCallAsync
members.description: Notes an out-of-band JS interop call so the next capture's reflects it.

members.name: StartCaptureAsync
members.description: Starts a capture window for the given editor instance. Re-starting an existing capture overwrites the previous one without emitting a report.

members.name: StopCaptureAsync
members.description: Stops the capture window and returns the aggregated report. Returns null if no capture was active for the supplied instance.
